title: pilosella officinarum subsp. velutinoides
intro: Pilosella officinarum subsp. velutinoides, commonly known as a subspecies of the common knapweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health issues, such as gastrointestinal problems, and is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella officinarum subsp. velutinoides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
